summary: The conflict remains highly active with significant drone activity reported across multiple regions including Sumy, Kharkiv, and the Black Sea. Ukrainian forces conducted a strike on an FSB coordination center in Kherson using 13 drones, causing a large fire. Meanwhile, Russian forces reported significant civilian casualties and large-scale drone interceptions over Russian territory.
key_points: The SBU struck an FSB coordination center in Kherson with 13 drones, causing a large fire and targeting a site with approximately 100 military personnel (Source: @UkraineNow/82794).
Russian forces reported 209 Ukrainian drones were intercepted overnight over Russian regions and the Azov and Black Seas (Source: @tass_agency/386238).
A drone attack in Shebekino, Belgorod region, resulted in five deaths, including one child, and 23 civilian injuries (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31787).
Russian authorities reported nearly 70 civilian deaths due to Ukrainian strikes over the past week (Source: @tass_agency/386232).
Ukrainian forces targeted port infrastructure used for military cargo storage in the port of Chornomorsk, Odessa region (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31782).
A fire occurred at the Novolipetsky Steel Mill in Lipetsk region following a Ukrainian drone attack (Source: @eRadarrua/101881).
The Ukrainian General Staff denied rumors regarding the dismissal of Commander-in-Chief Oleksandr Syrskyi (Source: @UkraineNow/82796).
President Zelenskyy held a special meeting with corps commanders and weapon manufacturers to discuss frontline needs and drone production (Source: @UkraineNow/82802).

sections.executive_summary: The operational environment is characterized by high-intensity drone warfare and targeted strikes on infrastructure. Significant developments include a large-scale strike on an FSB coordination center in Kherson and widespread drone activity over the Black Sea and Russian border regions. Political shifts in the UK and internal Ukrainian leadership discussions are also noted.

points: The SBU conducted a strike on an FSB coordination center in Kherson using 13 drones, resulting in a large fire and targeting a facility with approximately 100 military personnel (Source: @UkraineNow/82794).
President Zelenskyy convened a special meeting with corps commanders and weapon manufacturers to discuss frontline requirements, drone supply, and ammunition (Source: @UkraineNow/82802).
The General Staff denied reports that Commander-in-Chief Oleksandr Syrskyi has been dismissed, stating he and Andriy Hnatov continue their duties (Source: @UkraineNow/82796).

Russian forces claimed to have taken members of the 'Skelya' regiment prisoner during a clearing operation in Kostiantynivka, Donetsk region (Source: @UkraineNow/82792).
Russian forces conducted KAB glide bomb strikes in the Donetsk region toward the east of Dnipropetrovsk (Source: @kpszsu/69438).

sections.threat_assessment: The high volume of drone interceptions and strikes on infrastructure indicates a sustained campaign of attrition. The use of reactive drones and glide bombs (KAB) suggests an escalation in aerial bombardment capabilities. The targeting of civilian infrastructure and transport in border regions remains a significant threat to non-combatants.
sections.regional_response: The UK has seen a change in leadership with Andy Burnham replacing Keir Starmer, though the stance on supporting Ukraine is expected to remain (Source: @UkraineNow/82795). In Central Asia, tensions are rising due to perceived Russian efforts to decouple the region from Russia through 'decolonization' narratives (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31778).
sections.intelligence_notes: The reported strike on the FSB coordination center in Kherson highlights the increasing precision and impact of Ukrainian drone operations against high-value command nodes. The denial of leadership changes in the Ukrainian General Staff suggests an effort to maintain internal stability and command continuity.
